t: You're on Camden Road, a main road running from Camden Town station up to Holloway Road. It's part of the A503, which carries on east as Tollington Road. Two people died on this road. John Stephenson Rowntree was a director of Rowntree's, the York confectionery company, and a reformer of the Quaker movement in the United Kingdom. He was the eldest son of Joseph Rowntree. Arthur John Wood was a barrister and secretary to the statute law revision commission.
